The scientific consensus is that there is no link between the MMR vaccine and autism. Multiple large, well-conducted studies across different countries have found no association. The original 1998 study suggesting a connection was retracted due to serious methodological flaws and ethical violations, and its author lost his medical license.

Major organizations confirming this include:
- World Health Organization (WHO)
- Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
- National Institutes of Health (NIH)
- Royal College of Physicians
